children: enCore Energy amended its purchase and registration rights agreements with Resulting Verdera and NM Energy Holding Canada, granting Verdera a right of first offer on certain transfers. The right covers proposed transfers of at least 30% of enCore Energy's Resulting Verdera shares while it owns 5% or more of the company's shares, and transfers of specified royalty rights to non-affiliates; the amendment also revises registration rights.
: Amendment to purchase and registration rights agreements
: Verdera Energy and NM Energy Holding Canada
: Share-transfer right applies until enCore Energy owns less than 5% of Resulting Verdera; royalty-transfer right term not specified
: Establish transfer protections and revise registration rights
